# LAMMPS input script for melting silicon and calculating self-diffusion coefficient
# Task: Heat Si from 300K to 2500K, equilibrate, and compute diffusion coefficient

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data /results/react/silicon_melting_2_trial_2/si_structure.data
replicate 3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 0 every 1 check yes

# Compute initial temperature
velocity all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

# Thermodynamic output settings
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Stage 1: Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# Temperature change: 2200 K
# Rate: 2.2 K/ps, so time = 2200/2.2 = 1000 ps
# Timestep: 0.001 ps, so steps = 1000/0.001 = 1,000,000
timestep 0.001
fix npt_heat all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run 1000000
unfix npt_heat

# Stage 2: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps under NPT
# Time: 500 ps, steps = 500/0.001 = 500,000
fix npt_equil all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Reset timestep counter for MSD calculation
reset_timestep 0

# Compute MSD for all atoms
compute msd_compute all msd com yes

# Output MSD data
fix msd_output all print 1000 "$(step) $(c_msd_compute[1]) $(c_msd_compute[2]) $(c_msd_compute[3]) $(c_msd_compute[4])" &
    file /results/react/silicon_melting_2_trial_2/msd_data.txt screen no title "# Step MSD_x MSD_y MSD_z MSD_total"

run 500000

unfix npt_equil
unfix msd_output

print "Simulation completed successfully"

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', skiprows=2)

# Extract columns
timesteps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert timesteps to time in picoseconds
# Timestep = 0.001 ps, output every 1000 steps
time_ps = timesteps * 0.001  # time in picoseconds

# For better statistics, use the second half of the data for fitting
# This avoids the initial transient behavior
start_idx = len(time_ps) // 2
time_fit = time_ps[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:]

print(f"Total data points: {len(time_ps)}")
print(f"Using data points from index {start_idx} to {len(time_ps)-1} for fitting")
print(f"Time range for fitting: {time_fit[0]:.1f} ps to {time_fit[-1]:.1f} ps")

# Perform linear regression: MSD = 6*D*t
# slope = 6*D (in Angstrom^2/ps)
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

print(f"\nLinear fit results:")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Angstrom^2")
print(f"R-squared: {r_value**2:.6f}")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6 (in Angstrom^2/ps)
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0

print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"D = {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# 1 Angstrom^2/ps = (1e-10)^2 / (1e-12) m^2/s = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * 1e-8

print(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"\nFinal answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Save the result
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"\nLinear fit parameters:\n")
    f.write(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Angstrom^2\n")
    f.write(f"R-squared: {r_value**2:.6f}\n")
    f.write(f"\nData range used for fitting:\n")
    f.write(f"Time: {time_fit[0]:.1f} ps to {time_fit[-1]:.1f} ps\n")
    f.write(f"Number of points: {len(time_fit)}\n")

# Create plots
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5))

# Plot 1: Full MSD vs time
ax1.plot(time_ps, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
ax1.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (R²={r_value**2:.4f})')
ax1.set_xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time', fontsize=14)
ax1.legend(fontsize=10)
ax1.grid(true, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Fitted region only
ax2.plot(time_fit, msd_fit, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
ax2.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit\nD = {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s')
ax2.set_xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_title('Linear Fit Region for Diffusion Coefficient', fontsize=14)
ax2.legend(fontsize=10)
ax2.grid(true, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_analysis.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print(f"\nPlot saved as msd_analysis.png")

print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"FINAL RESULT: {D_m2_s:.2e} m^2/s")
print(f"{'='*60}")

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Task: Calculate self-diffusion coefficient at 2500K

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data       si.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Thermodynamic output settings
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# ==========================================
# PHASE 1: Heating from 300K to 2500K
# Heating rate: 2.2 K/ps
# Time: (2500-300)/2.2 = 1000 ps = 1,000,000 steps
# ==========================================

# Initialize velocities at 300K
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

# NPT ensemble with ramping temperature
fix             heat all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)

# Run heating phase
run             1000000

unfix           heat

# ==========================================
# PHASE 2: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps
# Time: 500 ps = 500,000 steps
# ==========================================

# NPT ensemble at 2500K
fix             equil all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)

# Run equilibration without MSD calculation first (to ensure proper equilibration)
run             250000

# ==========================================
# PHASE 3: Production run with MSD calculation
# Time: 250 ps = 250,000 steps
# ==========================================

# Reset timestep for MSD calculation
reset_timestep  0

# Compute MSD for all atoms
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Output MSD data
fix             msd_output all print 1000 "$(step) $(c_msd[1]) $(c_msd[2]) $(c_msd[3]) $(c_msd[4])" &
                file msd_data.txt screen no title "# Step MSD_x MSD_y MSD_z MSD_total"

# Run production phase
run             250000

# Cleanup
unfix           equil
unfix           msd_output

print           "Simulation completed successfully"

print('Results saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt')

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Task: Calculate self-diffusion coefficient at 2500K

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data       si.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential (Stillinger-Weber)
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Thermodynamic output
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Velocity initialization at 300K
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

# Heating phase: 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps (1000 ps = 1,000,000 steps)
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run             1000000
unfix           1

# Equilibration phase at 2500K for 500 ps (500,000 steps)
reset_timestep  0

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient calculation
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Output MSD data
fix             2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
fix             msd_output all print 100 "$(step) $(c_msd[1]) $(c_msd[2]) $(c_msd[3]) $(c_msd[4])" file msd_data.txt screen no title "# Step MSD_x MSD_y MSD_z MSD_total"

run             500000

unfix           2
unfix           msd_output

print           "Simulation completed successfully"

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       silicon.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Settings
neighbor        0.3 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Initialize velocities at 300K
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

# Define computes for output
compute         myTemp all temp
compute         myPress all pressure myTemp

# Thermodynamic output
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol
thermo          1000

# ============================================
# Stage 1: Heating from 300K to 2500K
# Heating rate: 2.2 K/ps
# Time needed: (2500-300)/2.2 = 1000 ps
# Timestep: 0.001 ps = 1 fs
# Steps: 1,000,000
# ============================================

timestep        0.001

fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)

run             1000000

unfix           1

# ============================================
# Stage 2: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps
# Steps: 500,000
# ============================================

reset_timestep  0

fix             2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)

run             500000

unfix           2

# ============================================
# Stage 3: Production run for MSD calculation
# Run for 500 ps to collect MSD data
# ============================================

reset_timestep  0

# Continue NPT at 2500K
fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)

# Compute MSD
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Output MSD data every 100 steps
variable        step_var equal step
variable        msd_x equal c_msd[1]
variable        msd_y equal c_msd[2]
variable        msd_z equal c_msd[3]
variable        msd_total equal c_msd[4]

fix             msd_output all print 100 "${step_var} ${msd_x} ${msd_y} ${msd_z} ${msd_total}" file msd_data.txt screen no title "# step msd_x msd_y msd_z msd_total"

thermo          1000

run             500000

unfix           3
unfix           msd_output

# Write final structure
write_data      final_structure.data

print           "Simulation completed successfully"

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', comments='#')
timesteps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]

# Convert timesteps to time in ps (timestep = 0.001 ps)
time_ps = timesteps * 0.001

# Plot MSD vs time to visualize
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd, 'b-', linewidth=1)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time')
plt.grid(true)
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

# For diffusion coefficient, we need to fit the linear regime
# Typically, we skip the initial transient and fit the later part
# Let's use the last 60% of the data for fitting (more stable liquid regime)
start_idx = int(0.4 * len(time_ps))
time_fit = time_ps[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd[start_idx:]

# Linear fit: MSD = slope * t + intercept
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

print(f"Linear fit statistics:")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom²/ps")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Angstrom²")
print(f"R²: {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"Standard error: {std_err:.6f}")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient using Einstein relation: D = MSD / (6t)
# From linear fit: MSD = slope * t, so D = slope / 6
D_angstrom2_per_ps = slope / 6.0

print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"D = {D_angstrom2_per_ps:.6e} Angstrom²/ps")

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Angstrom²/ps = 1e-20 / 1e-12 m²/s = 1e-8 m²/s
D_m2_per_s = D_angstrom2_per_ps * 1e-8

print(f"D = {D_m2_per_s:.6e} m²/s")
print(f"\nFinal answer: {D_m2_per_s:.2e}")

# Plot with fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (last 60%): slope={slope:.2f} Ų/ps, R²={r_value**2:.4f}')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time with Linear Fit')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(true)
plt.savefig('msd_with_fit.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print("\nPlots saved as 'msd_plot.png' and 'msd_with_fit.png'")

# Save result to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"=====================================\n")
    f.write(f"Linear fit range: {time_fit[0]:.1f} - {time_fit[-1]:.1f} ps\n")
    f.write(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom²/ps\n")
    f.write(f"R²: {r_value**2:.6f}\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_angstrom2_per_ps:.6e} Angstrom²/ps\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_per_s:.6e} m²/s\n")
    f.write(f"\nFinal answer (m²/s): {D_m2_per_s:.2e}\n")

print("Results saved to 'diffusion_coefficient.txt'")

Start from a crystalline silicon structure, which is replicated three times in each direction. The Stillinger-Weber (SW) potential should be used to describe interatomic interactions. Heat the system from 300K to 2500K at a rate of 2.2 K/ps, then equilibrate the liquid for 500 ps. Use the Einstein relation to compute the diffusion coefficient from the mean squared displacement (MSD) data. Report the diffusion coefficient in units of m²/s.

- Temperature range: 300K to 2500K = 2200K
- Time for heating: 2200K / 2.2 K/ps = 1000 ps
- Timestep: typically 1 fs = 0.001 ps for metal units
- Steps for heating: 1000 ps / 0.001 ps = 1,000,000 steps
- Steps for equilibration: 500 ps / 0.001 ps = 500,000 steps

# Task: Calculate self-diffusion coefficient at 2500K

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data       silicon.data
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Thermodynamic output
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Initial velocity at 300K
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

unfix           msd_output

"}</action_input>

- The factor of 6 comes from 3D diffusion

From the data:

<action_input>{"path": "/results/react/silicon_melting_2_trial_78/analyze_msd.py", "content": "import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd.dat', comments='#')
timestep = data[:, 0]  # in timesteps
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert timestep to time in picoseconds
# timestep = 0.001 ps, output every 100 steps
time_ps = timestep * 0.001 * 100  # time in ps

# For diffusion coefficient calculation, we need the linear region
# Typically use the last 50-70% of the data
start_idx = int(0.3 * len(time_ps))  # Start from 30% to avoid initial transient
end_idx = len(time_ps)

time_linear = time_ps[start_idx:end_idx]
msd_linear = msd_total[start_idx:end_idx]

# Perform linear regression on MSD vs time
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_linear, msd_linear)

print(f"Linear fit from {time_linear[0]:.1f} ps to {time_linear[-1]:.1f} ps")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"R^2: {r_value**2:.6f}")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient using Einstein relation
# D = MSD / (6t) for 3D diffusion
# slope = d(MSD)/dt, so D = slope / 6
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0  # in Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Angstrom^2/ps = 1e-20 m^2 / 1e-12 s = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"D = {D_A2_ps:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"D = {D_m2_s:.10e} m^2/s (full precision)")

# Plot MSD vs time
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_total, 'b-', label='MSD data', linewidth=1)
plt.plot(time_linear, slope * time_linear + intercept, 'r--', 
         label=f'Linear fit (R²={r_value**2:.4f})', linewidth=2)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save the result
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"Linear fit range: {time_linear[0]:.1f} ps to {time_linear[-1]:.1f} ps\n")
    f.write(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"R^2: {r_value**2:.6f}\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_A2_ps:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.10e} m^2/s\n")

print("\nResults saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")
"}</action_input>

- Equilibration: 500 ps = 500,000 steps

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data si_structure.data
replicate 3 3 3

# Define potential
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Set masses (Si = 28.0855 g/mol)
mass 1 28.0855

# Define groups
group all type 1

# Timestep
timestep 0.001  # 1 fs

# Thermodynamic output
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Initial velocity at 300K
velocity all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

run 1000000
unfix npt_heat

fix npt_equil all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)

run 500000

# Clean up
unfix npt_equil
unfix msd_output
uncompute msd_compute

print "Simulation completed successfully"

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', comments='#')

# Extract columns: step, MSD_x, MSD_y, MSD_z, MSD_total
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert steps to time in ps (timestep = 0.001 ps)
timestep = 0.001  # ps
time = (steps - steps[0]) * timestep  # Time in ps

# Plot MSD vs time to visualize
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print(f"Total data points: {len(time)}")
print(f"Time range: {time[0]:.2f} - {time[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"MSD range: {msd_total[0]:.2f} - {msd_total[-1]:.2f} Ų")

# For diffusion coefficient, we use the linear region
# Skip initial transient (first 10% of data) and use the rest
skip_fraction = 0.1
start_idx = int(len(time) * skip_fraction)

time_fit = time[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
# So slope = 6*D, therefore D = slope/6
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

print(f"\nLinear fit (using data from {time_fit[0]:.2f} to {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps):")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Ų/ps")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Ų")
print(f"R²: {r_value**2:.6f}")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6 (in Ų/ps)
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0

print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient (Ų/ps): {D_angstrom_ps:.6e}")

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Ų = 1e-20 m²
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Ų/ps = 1e-20 / 1e-12 = 1e-8 m²/s
D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Diffusion coefficient (m²/s): {D_m2_s:.6e}")

# Plot with fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, slope*time_fit + intercept, 'r-', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (R²={r_value**2:.4f})')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
plt.title(f'MSD vs Time with Linear Fit\nD = {D_m2_s:.3e} m²/s', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.savefig('msd_fit_plot.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print(f"\nPlots saved: msd_plot.png and msd_fit_plot.png")

# Save result to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Ų/ps\n")
    f.write(f"\nFit details:\n")
    f.write(f"Slope = {slope:.6f} Ų/ps\n")
    f.write(f"R² = {r_value**2:.6f}\n")
    f.write(f"Data range for fit: {time_fit[0]:.2f} - {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps\n")

print("\nResult saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")
print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"FINAL RESULT: D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s")
print(f"{'='*60}")
"}</action_input>

# LAMMPS input script for melting silicon and calculating diffusion coefficient
# Task: Heat from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps, equilibrate for 500 ps, compute MSD

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure and replicate
read_data si_structure.data
replicate 3 3 3

# Define potential
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Set neighbor list
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 5 every 1

# Timestep
timestep 0.001  # 1 fs

# Define computes for output
compute myTemp all temp
compute myPress all pressure myTemp
compute myPE all pe
compute myKE all ke

# Thermo output
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Initial velocities at 300K
velocity all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

# Heating phase: 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps under NPT (zero pressure)
# Time needed: (2500-300)/2.2 = 1000 ps = 1,000,000 steps
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
run 1000000
unfix 1

# Reset timestep for equilibration phase
reset_timestep 0

# Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps = 500,000 steps
# Setup MSD computation for diffusion coefficient
compute msd all msd com yes

# Output MSD data
fix 2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 $(100.0*dt) iso 0.0 0.0 $(1000.0*dt)
fix msd_output all print 100 "${step} $(c_msd[1]) $(c_msd[2]) $(c_msd[3]) $(c_msd[4])" file msd_data.txt screen no title "# step msd_x msd_y msd_z msd_total"

run 500000

unfix 2
unfix msd_output

print "Simulation completed successfully"

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', comments='#')

# Extract columns: step, MSD_x, MSD_y, MSD_z, MSD_total
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert steps to time in ps (timestep = 0.001 ps)
timestep = 0.001  # ps
time = (steps - steps[0]) * timestep  # Time in ps

# Plot MSD vs time to visualize
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.grid(true, alpha=0.3)
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print(f"Total data points: {len(time)}")
print(f"Time range: {time[0]:.2f} - {time[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"MSD range: {msd_total[0]:.2f} - {msd_total[-1]:.2f} Ų")

# For diffusion coefficient, we use the linear region
# Skip initial transient (first 10% of data) and use the rest
skip_fraction = 0.1
start_idx = int(len(time) * skip_fraction)

time_fit = time[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
# So slope = 6*D, therefore D = slope/6
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

print(f"\nLinear fit (using data from {time_fit[0]:.2f} to {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps):")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Ų/ps")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Ų")
print(f"R²: {r_value**2:.6f}")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6 (in Ų/ps)
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0

print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient (Ų/ps): {D_angstrom_ps:.6e}")

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Ų = 1e-20 m²
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Ų/ps = 1e-20 / 1e-12 = 1e-8 m²/s
D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Diffusion coefficient (m²/s): {D_m2_s:.6e}")

# Plot with fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, slope*time_fit + intercept, 'r-', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (R²={r_value**2:.4f})')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
plt.title(f'MSD vs Time with Linear Fit\nD = {D_m2_s:.3e} m²/s', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(true, alpha=0.3)
plt.savefig('msd_fit_plot.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

print(f"\nPlots saved: msd_plot.png and msd_fit_plot.png")

# Save result to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Ų/ps\n")
    f.write(f"\nFit details:\n")
    f.write(f"Slope = {slope:.6f} Ų/ps\n")
    f.write(f"R² = {r_value**2:.6f}\n")
    f.write(f"Data range for fit: {time_fit[0]:.2f} - {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps\n")

print("\nResult saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")
print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"FINAL RESULT: D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s")
print(f"{'='*60}")
